description: A very unique trail designed to connect numerous small communities together for snowmobile use. The trail starts/ends in Clinton and runs Northbound to the community of Likely via 100 Mile and Horsefly. Please note, water crossing structures on this trail will have a maximum width of 60", public with wider vehicles may have to bypass these structures.
directions:
From Hwy 97 head East to community of Likely, turn right onto the South Likely Road, follow this for 1.25km, the trail veers to the right and up the hill.

From here it is approximately 343km South to Clinton, with access along that trail at the 52.5km marker on the 2300 (Redeau Lake Road), Hwy 97 at Wright Station Road, 99 Mile Snowmobile Club House, Stormy Road, 70 Mile House or Clinton.
Trail is marked with a yellow sign with a black directional arrow.
title: Gold Rush Snowmobile Trail
